title: test(docs): check examples in PRs to stop broken docs
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Added PR checks for generated write-request examples across Gen, Enter and Media. The validator parses emitted curl commands, checks their URLs, headers and bodies against the original OpenAPI schemas, and requires a body example when a route requires one; failures block the PR. Enter checks cover public account paths and the quest catalog, not private dashboard routes. The checks cover POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE examples, not read examples. Multipart file placeholders are checked for presence and schema, not file contents.
